name: Triumph
overview: Scripture reveals that true triumph is found in Christ's victory over the world and the freedom He grants believers. Though we face tribulation, Jesus assures us peace and encourages us to be of good cheer because He has overcome the world (John 16:33). This triumph is experienced through justification by faith, resulting in peace with God (Romans 5:1), redemption through His blood (Ephesians 1:7), and the liberty from bondage to sin (Galatians 5:1). Believers are called to live as children of light, walking in the victory and joy that come from abiding in Christ (Ephesians 5:8; John 16:24).
